graph.title: LEGO City 60059 Logging Truck

new_part_types.name: Log stake (black post with pin base)

notes: Steps are pictures only; where the picture does not show exactly which stud a piece sits on, I chose the most plausible neighbouring part. Ports are left null on most joins for that reason.
Element IDs were read from the inventory pages (78-79). Parts not in the catalogue got new types, with names and ports inferred from the step images.

b68 uses lego-9566 because the booklet's parts page prints exactly '9566' for the blue steering wheel on a plate. I reverted my earlier invented 956623, which is not on the page. Page 78 prints this id as shown, so I kept it.

[L1] The two count mismatches look like artifacts of the extracted text, which lists some ids twice. 4211452 (grey plate 2x6): the picture shows '2x', and the build uses it exactly twice, in steps 14 and 16. 6037621 (roof rack): only one rack is pictured and built, in step 31. I kept 2 and 1 pieces. Adding pieces that no step uses would make the graph wrong.

[L3] The booklet builds one model, the logging truck. The chainsaw rests on the truck rear in the final picture (page 74), so it has a contact edge to the rear deck plate. It is also held by the chainsaw minifig (page 5), so that minifig is linked through a contact edge. The lumberjack in the cab has a contact edge to the cab floor. The two logs rest on the deck, so each has a contact edge to the green 4x6 or 2x3 deck plates. These contact edges are approximate.

[V2/L3] Tree 1 (b16) and tree 2 (b17) are loose accessories. Pages 3 and 5 show them as separate pieces, and page 74 shows them standing on the ground beside the truck, touching nothing. I kept them as separate nodes and did not invent a connection. That is why they have no edges and why the graph has two extra separate groups.

Catalogue entries lego-614126, lego-4225201 and lego-4538007 were reused because the ID matches. Their catalogue descriptions differ from the booklet pictures (small black round plate; cab mirror; liftarm piece).
Element 4210678 is drawn as a black 2x10 plate. 6039176 is a black plate roughly 3x3. 4184169 is the black pin rod on the crane claw. Names are best guesses.

The two logs are one repeat (2x). Each is 10 round bricks (4211166) on a ribbed rod (370826), with one end clip (4648118) placed after the 5th brick. The 6 wheel stations (holder, green plate, mudguard, hub, tyre) are one repeat. The wheel-holder-to-chassis joins are approximate: copies 1-2 sit on the rear plate, 3-4 on the middle plate and 5-6 on the front plate.
Both side-guard assemblies (step 15, 2x) are one repeat. They attach to the two 1x16 side bricks.
Stickers (grille, number plate, hazard stripes, side logos) are not parts and are omitted.
Chain joins (pair across the truck) and the exact position of cab clips, mirrors and beacons are approximated from the small step images.
